findings.claim: A successful configured unit command can contribute no evidence while the harness exits 0 with only browser cases.
findings.evidence: Lines 61–65 run unitCommand and check only its status. Lines 81–86 use "if (source && existsSync(source))" and reject only "if (suites.length === 0)". Therefore a unit command returning 0 without writing unitJunitPath, or writing a report containing no matching suites, is silently omitted when browser cases exist. unitCommand can also be configured without unitJunitPath.
findings.suggested_fix: Require unitJunitPath when unitCommand is configured, and require each configured suite's fresh report to exist and contain valid cases. Record a harness error and return nonzero if either report is missing or invalid.

findings.claim: The merge can reuse a stale browser report after a browser invocation fails before producing a new report.
findings.evidence: Startup removes "rmSync(report, { force: true })" and optionally unitJunitPath, but the separate "const browserReport = resolve(outputDir, 'browser-junit.xml')" is never deleted. The merge subsequently reads any existing browserReport. A spawn error or timeout before reporter output therefore copies previous-run cases into the newly written merged report. The nonzero command status prevents exit 0 in that scenario, but the report still falsely attributes old cases to this run.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve and delete browserReport before starting checks. If browser execution produces no fresh valid report, include a current-run harness error instead of importing previous cases.
ac_ids: Phase B harness contract: remove previous-run evidence
